**🎨 Studio Just Got a Major Upgrade!**
- Experience lightning-fast performance, a new built-in template library, and a buttery-smooth editing experience in the Studio builder.

**⚙️ Custom Functions, Supercharged**
- We've enhanced our functions for more reliable execution and a seamless creation process. Building custom logic is now easier than ever.

**📚 Train Your AI in Record Time**
- **50% Faster Training**: Boost your agent's learning speed from websites, FAQs, and text. Get your AI up and running in half the time!
- **Pinpoint Accuracy**: Enjoy greater control and flexibility when training on multiple data sources for more precise AI responses.

**🔄 Seamless Helpdesk Migration**
- Switch to YourGPT in minutes! Our Helpdesk Migrator now supports [Intercom](https://help.yourgpt.ai/article/how-to-import-articles-from-intercom-into-yourgpt-3611), [Crisp](https://help.yourgpt.ai/article/how-to-import-articles-from-crisp-into-yourgpt-3610), [Zendesk](https://help.yourgpt.ai/article/how-to-import-articles-from-zendesk-help-center-into-yourgpt-3612), [Zoho](https://help.yourgpt.ai/article/how-to-import-zoho-articles-into-yourgpt-3657), and [HelpDocs](https://help.yourgpt.ai/article/how-to-helpdocs-import-articles-into-yourgpt-3656).

**📊 Keep Track with Audit Logs**
- Stay on top of all organizational activities with our new detailed audit log. Track changes and maintain security with ease.

**📝 Your Monthly Performance Briefing**
- Get a monthly email recap of your AI agents' performance, including conversations handled, response quality, and time saved.

**📱 YourGPT On-the-Go**
- Our [Andorid](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yourgpt.chatbot&hl=en_IN) & [iOS](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/your-ai-chatbot/id6499470819) mobile app has been updated with new improvements and fixes for a smoother experience wherever you are.

**📧 Master Your Inbox with Gmail Support**
- Reply to emails faster directly inside Gmail with the YourGPT Web Extension. Your new productivity hack is here.

**🖼️ Image Understanding in Chats**
- Your AI can now analyze and answer from images to users directly in conversations.

**🎨 Studio Improvements**
- We've made the studio more easier to use, so you can build and edit flows more efficiently.

**🧑‍✈️ New: Agent Mode**
- Let your AI handle complex tasks. [Agent Mode](https://help.yourgpt.ai/article/what-is-the-difference-between-chat-mode-agent-mode-2674#what-is-agent-mode) enables it to complete multi-step operations using a variety of tools.

**🤖 Build Your Own AI Copilot**
- Introducing the [Copilot Builder](https://yourgpt.ai/copilot-builder). Add an AI Copilot to your product to turn user conversations into actions, automate workflows, and manage tasks across SaaS, e-commerce, support, and more.

**Key Features:**
- Reasons and plans before answering
- Completes multi-step tasks
- Understands both text and images
- Browses the web for instant answers
